# Every 24 months the republic votes; the government's seats move with stability, war, discontent and the campaign.
country_event = {
	id = lr_election.1
	title = lr_election.1.t
	desc = lr_election.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_election_vote

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			lr_fra_election_count = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = lr_election.1.a
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = LR_election_swing }
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_seats min = 100 max = 560 }
		lr_fra_sync_seats = yes
		add_stability = 0.02
	}

	option = {
		name = lr_election.1.b
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = LR_election_swing }
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = 6 }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_seats min = 100 max = 560 }
		lr_fra_sync_seats = yes
		add_war_support = 0.03
	}

	option = {
		name = lr_election.1.c
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = LR_election_swing }
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = 12 }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_seats min = 100 max = 560 }
		lr_fra_sync_seats = yes
		add_stability = -0.03
	}
}

# Six months without a majority: the Chamber moves a vote of no confidence.
country_event = {
	id = lr_election.2
	title = lr_election.2.t
	desc = lr_election.2.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_parliament

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = lr_election.2.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 40 }
		add_political_power = -100
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = 45 }
		lr_fra_sync_seats = yes
		add_stability = -0.03
	}

	option = {
		name = lr_election.2.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 40 }
		set_variable = { LR_election_clock = 0 }
		country_event = { id = lr_election.1 days = 3 }
	}

	option = {
		name = lr_election.2.c
		ai_chance = { factor = 20 }
		add_stability = -0.1
		add_war_support = -0.05
		add_to_variable = { LR_seats = 20 }
		lr_fra_sync_seats = yes
	}
}
